<p>I'm a second-year BEng Computer Science student at Anglia Ruskin University in Cambridge, UK.</p>
<p>I'm particularly interested in computer architecture, embedded systems, and understanding how things work at a lower level. I enjoy combining my personal interests with programming through projects of my own. That includes building and running <strong>Atlas</strong>, a home server I built from salvaged PC parts, and developing <strong><a href="https://github.com/george-cliff/murmur">Murmur</a></strong>, where I'm exploring offline bird-call detection using embedded systems and machine learning. I'm also starting to document what I'm working on and what I learn along the way on <strong><a href="https://georgecliff.com/">my website</a></strong>.</p>

## 🛠️ What I'm up to

### 🔭 What I'm working on

- Developing **[Murmur](https://github.com/george-cliff/murmur)** and making a start on **Triarch**.
- Building my **[personal website](https://github.com/george-cliff/personal-site)** as a place for project write-ups, notes and things I find interesting.
- This trimester at university, I'm working on:
  - **Software Engineering:** building a C# web app with a team for a live industry brief, designed to help engineers search medical-device recall notices and turn their findings into reports.
  - **Database Design and Implementation:** designing a database for a hospital management system as part of a live client brief, covering ER modelling, implementation, security and auditing.

### 🌱 What I'm learning

- Learning more about computer architecture and systems programming, starting with RISC-V.
- Practising C and learning C++, Rust and SystemVerilog.
- Learning more about machine learning with PyTorch for Murmur, and relational databases with MySQL at university.
